scenes.name: last-pool
scenes.prompt: An immense ivory nautilus shell lies half buried in a vast cracked terracotta desert beneath an ink-blue dusk sky. The shell is a sculpted vessel tilted toward us, its open chamber containing the last pool of luminous turquoise water. A small vermilion wooden boat rests on this pool, carrying a single round glowing pearl in its hull. A narrow silver-blue stream escapes the shell toward the lower right and winds far across the dry landscape. On the distant horizon stands one enormous closed ivory flower bud. The shell occupies the left half, the red boat is clearly readable near the middle, and the right half opens into spacious desert and twilight. An exquisite surrealist oil painting with dimensional carved ivory, jewel-colored enamel, deep velvet shadows, warm copper earth, delicate engraved textures and precise luminous highlights. Monumental distinct silhouettes, tactile detail, poetic dream logic and generous negative space.

prompt_schedule.name: the-city-releases-its-light
prompt_schedule.prompt: A large translucent jellyfish with a golden pearl heart floats below the last ivory arch of a submerged city. Smaller glowing jellyfish gather beside it. A broad turquoise current flows across the image, lifting fine golden tendrils. The carved arch begins to unravel into pale ribbons of water and light. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. Tactile carved surfaces, crisp engraved detail, luminous reflected light and deep velvet shadows. Monumental readable silhouettes, generous open space and poetic dream logic.

prompt_schedule.name: stone-becomes-current
prompt_schedule.prompt: A luminous jellyfish with a pearl at its heart drifts through a great turquoise current. The remaining ivory arch dissolves into flowing pale ribbons that curl around the creature and trail away. Small golden jellyfish glow at different depths in open dark-blue water. The current has a sweeping diagonal shape and the scene becomes spacious. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. prompt_schedule.name: open-ocean
prompt_schedule.prompt: A magnificent translucent jellyfish with a bright golden pearl heart floats in a boundless deep-blue ocean. Long graceful gold and ivory tendrils sweep sideways in a broad current. Several smaller jellyfish glow farther away, spaced widely apart. The background is pure velvety open water with diagonal turquoise light rays and drifting sparks. A tiny vermilion ribbon recalls the shape of a distant red boat. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. prompt_schedule.prompt: A constellation of luminous jellyfish travels through spacious turquoise and ultramarine water. One large transparent pearlescent bell with a golden heart leads several smaller creatures at different depths. Their fine golden trails draw loose arcs through the water. A bright diffuse glow above hints at the surface. Each creature has a distinct readable silhouette, with open darkness between them. prompt_schedule.name: the-lights-rise
prompt_schedule.prompt: Graceful luminous jellyfish rise toward a bright silver-blue surface, their golden pearl hearts shining like lanterns. Long thin tendrils and a few small red ribbons stream below their transparent ivory bells. The largest bell occupies the left middle, while smaller lights curve away toward the upper right. The water grows paler and more luminous overhead. prompt_schedule.name: almost-air
prompt_schedule.prompt: Several glowing pearlescent bells float just beneath a shimmering water surface, resembling warm paper lanterns. Golden light fills their centers. Fine red and gold threads trail beneath them. The upper water becomes pale mist, and distant star-like lights shimmer beyond it. The dark blue depths remain below, making the boundary between ocean and sky feel thin.
